title: infra-ontology source, v1
description: One row of sources.parquet, in its JSON Lines form: where a set of facts came from, and when. A source that failed or was partial is recorded, so the snapshot never silently shrinks the estate.

source_id.description: The identifier nodes and edges cite.

kind.description: What kind of document the source is.

backend.description: The backend or store the document was read from, for example s3, gcs, azblob, hcp or local.

location.description: Where the document was read from. Hashed when ids are hashed.

workspace.description: The Terraform workspace, for a state.

serial.description: The state serial, for a state.

lineage.description: The state lineage, for a state.

terraform_version.description: The Terraform version that wrote the state.

document_sha256.description: The hex SHA-256 of the document that was read, so a reader can tell whether it has changed since.

collected_at.description: When the document was read, in UTC, as RFC 3339.

collector.description: The tool that read the document.

status.description: ok when the document was read in full, partial when part of it was not, failed when none of it was.

reason.description: Why a source is partial or failed. Empty when ok.
